item.title: Rallying Cry – October 15, 2026
item.description: Brain implants are giving voices back to those who’ve lost them, a swimmer’s emotional plea for cancer research leads to a meeting with the PM, Slovenia fights to save its last glacier, and two adorable baby capybaras just joined the San Francisco Zoo!
